title: kith-tui: advance ReadPosition so unreadCount clears
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 Chat.unreadCount is derived from ReadPosition.lastReadMessageId; Message.readAt does not affect it. kith-tui only sets readAt, so against jmap-testjig the chat-list badge (e.g. 'alice (5)') never decreases. Needs ReadPosition/get + ReadPosition/set (lastReadMessageId = newest id) when a chat is viewed.
close_reason: On chat view (startup, selection change) and on SSE arrivals in the viewed chat, ReadPosition/get then ReadPosition/set lastReadMessageId = greatest displayed id; never moves backwards; no-op when no ReadPosition exists. Displayed own messages count as read (client-side reading (a) of chinwag-fqk0; server unchanged).
